Ayer Collection material, predominantly Indigenous-language texts, grammars, catechisms and Americana. Correct anything that does not match Newberry's own shelf/box naming. AYER12BX's box number was inferred from the code, not confirmed. (Migrated into this manifest from newberry_shipment_names.json.)
